outline: In this course we will think about the interplay of inspiration and composition in the role of the lyric. What is the relationship of the authentic to the poetic, the spontaneous to the formal, the voiced to the read? We will read a survey of poetry from the earliest recorded lyric in English to the twentieth century and selected essays.
